name: Fury of the Land
summary: A library seeks magical works for its collection. Your findings help expand its knowledge.

sections.title: A Place for Knowledge
sections.body: A librarian asks whether you have brought something to add. The librarian welcomes what you have found, and invites you to bring more if you discover it.

faq.answer: The Library seeks magical works that may benefit its collection.

faq.q: Where should I bring magical works?
faq.answer: Bring them to the librarian. Librarians gather such works in Stormwind and in the Undercity.

faq.q: Why are they collecting magical works?
faq.answer: The librarian says each contribution expands their knowledge.

attribution: In-game quest text: Fury of the Land
